technique_name: Describe the approach used by a startup to scale up from zero to one million customers within two years.
description: The startup employed robust marketing strategies such as investing in organic SEO and aggressive social media campaigns to reach a wide customer base online. They also implemented effective customer retention strategies, offering discounts to loyal customers, and providing excellent customer service.
